title: The Download: inside the quest to make our minds immortal
summary: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. What we learned when our Roundtables explored the quest to make minds immortal To preserve our sense of self, some scientists are working on ways to keep our brains going—even beyond…
llm_summary: The latest edition of **The Download** dives into the cutting‑edge research aimed at preserving consciousness after death. Scientists are exploring technologies—from whole‑brain emulation to advanced neural mapping—that could keep a person’s sense of self alive beyond the biological limits of the brain. The newsletter highlights the ethical, technical, and philosophical challenges these “mind‑immortality” projects raise for the future of technology.
